title: Association for Advancing Automation: North American companies ordered ~11K robots in Q3 2026, up 25% YoY, as they seek to ease labor shortages in manufacturing (Christian Davies/Financial Times)
summary: Christian Davies / Financial Times: Association for Advancing Automation: North American companies ordered ~11K robots in Q3 2026, up 25% YoY, as they seek to ease labor shortages in manufacturing — Some say speed of automation is still not fast enough to make country internationally competitive as manufacturing sector struggles
